title: Tiger Global Boosts Nvidia Stake to 27.4 Million USD
digest:
Tiger Global Management increased its Nvidia stake to 27.4 million USD, making it the largest institutional holder of Nvidia shares, according to Crypto Briefing (2026-11-17). The move, a 7% portfolio upgrade, reflects market confidence in Nvidia's AI chip dominance and comes ahead of Q3 financial results and CEO guidance updates. Earlier reports noted Tiger held Nvidia as its third-largest tech holding before this upgrade. 

The 7% stake increase applies only to Tiger's U.S.-based equity funds, with no indication of changes in other jurisdictions or investment vehicles. 

Analysts highlight the strategic timing as Nvidia prepares to launch its H100 AI chip next month, though no direct statements from Tiger or Nvidia confirm this connection.
